aSecretNameAndValueAreRequired: A secret name and value are required.
changesTheLanguageOfTheKandev: Changes the language of the Kandev interface. Applies immediately and is remembered on this device. Task titles, chat, and other content you create are not translated.
chooseTheLanguageUsedAcrossThe: Choose the language used across the Kandev interface
chooseWhatOpensWhenKandevStarts: Choose what opens when Kandev starts or you visit its bare home page
chooseWhichTranscriptNavigationControls: Choose which transcript navigation controls appear, including the desktop-only sticky prompt bar
configureArchiveSafeguardsAndDefaultsFor: Configure archive safeguards and defaults for tasks created by agents
configureBackendAndExecutionResourceSamp: Configure backend and execution resource sampling
connectionLostDescription: Connection lost for at least 10 seconds. Live updates may be stale.
customizeHowChangedFilesAreDisplayed: Customize how changed files are displayed
customizeKeyboardShortcutsForTheCommand: Customize keyboard shortcuts for the command panel
displayChangedFilesAsAFlat: Display changed files as a flat list with full paths, or as a folder tree.
makesAgentctlValuesAvailableToPlugins: Makes agentctl values available to plugins and other consumers. The built-in status bar remains host-only.
manageApiKeysAndCredentialsSecrets: Manage API keys and credentials. Secrets are encrypted at rest and injected into agent environments via executor profile env vars.
mcpTaskDefaultsAndArchiveSafeguards: MCP task defaults, archive safeguards, and transcript preferences
noSecretsYetAddYourFirst: No secrets yet. Add your first secret to get started.

pressEnterToSendMessagesPress: Press Enter to send messages. Press Shift+Enter for newlines.
removesTheHostMarkerAndProgress: Removes the Host marker and progress bars while retaining metric icons and values.
resumeTheMostRecentlyOpenedTask: Resume the most recently opened task in this workspace on this device.
shellTerminalFontsAndLinkBehavior: Shell, terminal fonts, and link behavior
showHostMetricsInStatusBar: Show host metrics in status bar
showsKandevHostValuesOnlyCollection: Shows Kandev host values only. Collection starts while a client displays them.
startOnYourSavedKanbanPipelineOrList: Start on your saved Kanban, Pipeline, or List view.
taskWorkbenchLayoutProfilesAndDefaults: Task workbench layout profiles and defaults
themeMetricsAndChangesPanelPreferences: Theme, startup page, metrics, and changes panel preferences
thisAppliesWhenKandevStarts: This applies when Kandev starts or you open its bare home page. Home, Back, and workflow navigation always open the task overview.
thisPageHasUnsavedChangesSave: This page has unsaved changes. Save them, discard them, or continue editing.
thisWillPermanentlyRemoveSecret: This will permanently remove <2>{{name}}</2>. This action cannot be undone.
usefulWhenKandevIsSelfHosted: Useful when Kandev is self-hosted on a remote server and you want a lightweight view of the machine resources from the global status bar or phone Status drawer.
